title: Plaid Institution Sync Gap
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plaid:account
| stats max(_time) as last_sync by institution
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_sync)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>12
| sort - hours_since
description: Uses Plaid account syncs telemetry to monitor time since each institution last refreshed in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for broken links before balances become stale, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Plaid account syncs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Institution table of hours since last sync.
grandmaExplanation: It flags time since each institution last refreshed so you can spot broken links before balances become stale before it becomes annoying.
